description: This Java class acts as a global exception handler in a Spring Boot application, providing consistent API error responses for various exceptions.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A controller advice class that handles various exceptions globally within the Spring Boot application, returning structured error responses.

classes.name: ErrorPayload
classes.description: A static inner class representing the standardized error response payload, including message, status, error, timestamp, and details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ErrorPayload instance initialized with given HttpStatus and message.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException by returning a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolation
methods.description: Handles ConstraintViolationException by returning a 400 Bad Request with validation violation details.

methods.name: handleMethodArgumentNotValid
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException for validation errors on method arguments.

methods.name: handleBindException
methods.description: Handles BindException for validation errors during binding process.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException, translating it into an appropriate HTTP response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles any other Exception not specifically caught, returning a 500 Internal Server Error.
